---
title: "Certificate of completion"
---

Participants who attend **3 to 5 of the 5 sessions** receive a Neudata certificate of completion, signed by the trainers My Luong Vuong and Bernard Isekah Osang'ir.

**How to get it:** in the form below, enter the email you registered with, then the 6-digit code we email you and your official full name. Your certificate is emailed to you as a PDF. Each certificate has a unique ID and a QR code that anyone can scan to verify it.

[Generate my certificate](https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyo0gY-ilc-g2PXHmEszcxyaCy6T1r7cqGhvq6hJSajmUnmvfWfexv5OKcGlbpRVSjaBA/exec?lang=en){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg role="button" target="_blank"}
